CustomObject.description: Work tracking settings (build 40), org default row only. Since build 47 it holds the switches for every tracker: tickets required, the ServiceNow change gate and the change format; the trackers are RLY_Work_Tracker__c records. Its build 40 tracker fields are read once, to make the first tracker. Read and written only by RlyWorkStore.
CustomObject.label: RLY Work Tracking
